༄༅/ /mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog skya'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba bzhugs so/ /

rin chen shog skya'i skor/ mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba zhes bya ba/ dpal snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin bde gshegs kun gyi dngos/ /padma rgyal zhes mngon spyod ma 'khrul pa'i/ /'gro ba'i bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa'i rim pas mthong ba'i snang tshul brjod/ /de la bskyed rdzogs thun mong gi mthong snang ba dang*/ 'od gsal mchog gi mthong snang gnyis las/ dang po la grub pa'i mthong snang ni/ rnal 'byor pa rab la mngon sum/ 'bring la nyams snang*/ tha ma la rmi lam du snang ste/ de yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa gang yin yang*/ dam can 'du bas mkha' 'gro'i rtags 'byung nges te/ mkha' 'gro'i gzugs dang sgra skad sna tshogs pas lung bstan cing*/ dngos grub ster ba dang*/ bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye ba dang*/ gsal snang mngon shes lta bu 'byung ba dang*/ gnyid 'od gsal bde ba chen por 'char ba dang*/ gzhan snang 'gyur bar nus pa dang*/ rang snang dga' bder 'bar ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa chos nyid du grol bar snang ba ni mngon sum dang nyams su myong ba'i snang ba'o/ /rmi lam du mchog gi rtags su shel gyi mchod rten la 'dzegs shing bskor ba byed pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'dri zhing mthong ba dang*/ rang nyid sangs rgyas par mthong ba dang*/ rang gis rang gi ro khur nas skyel ba dang*/ zhing khams bzang por phyin nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phrad pa dang*/ sngon ma thos pa'i chos zab mo thos pa dang*/ bya dang ri dwags ya mtshan can mthong ba dang*/ nyi zla'i steng du skyil krung bca' ba dang*/ rtag tu nam langs shing nyi ma shar ba rmi ba dang*/ rdzing dang zam pa 'dzugs pa dang*/ bdag nyid gru'i kha lo byas te chu'i pha rol tu phyin pa rmis na/ 'khor ba las thar pa'i lam sna zin te/ nges par grol ba'i ltas so/ /thun mongs la nad zhi ba'i ltas su lus las rnag khrag thon pa dang*/

gdon 'thon pa'i ltas su gzhan las rgyal ba dang*/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i ltas su nyi zla shar ba dang*/ gos dkar po gon pa dang*/ khrus byed pa dang*/ ri rtse la phyin pa dang*/ nam langs pa'o/ tshe 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i rtags su 'bru'i phung po dang*/ lo thog legs po dang*/ nyi zla shar ba'o/ /shes rab rgyas pa'i rtags su me tog 'thu ba dang*/ yi ge 'bri klog dang*/ dkar gsum 'thung ba dang*/ me 'bar ba dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ ral gri rnyed pa'o/ /grags pa rgyas pa'i rtags su dung 'bud pa dang*/ rnga brdung ba dang*/ dar po che phyar ba dang*/ kun gyis bstod pa rmi'o/ /nor rgyas pa'i rtags su/ rin po che'i char 'bab pa dang*/ gter 'dru ba dang*/ lo thog legs pa dang*/ khang bzangs longs spyod ldan pa rmi'o/ /'khor 'dab rgyas pa'i rtags su skye bo mang po'i dbus na 'dug pa dang*/ ba glang la sogs pa mang po skyong ba rmi'o/ /'gro ba dbang du 'du pa'i rtags su bud med mang pos phyag 'tshal zhing nor 'bul ba dang*/ zhal slob dang skye bo mang pos bstod pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma 'dus pa'i rtags su/ bud med mang pos phyag 'tshal rgyan 'dogs bstod pa'o/ /dpa' bo 'dus pa'i rtags su skye bo'i tshogs dang*/ dmag gi tshogs 'dus te phyag 'tshal zhing nor 'bul ba rmi'o/ /bgegs drag po tshar gcod pa'i rtags su/ gzhan bsad cing brdung ba dang*/ me dpung 'bar ba dang*/ rgya mtsho skam pa dang*/ chu chen po 'phral la 'bab 'phro chad pa dang*/ sems can phra mo mang po bsregs pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i sgra sgrogs pa rmi'o/ /ma grub pa'i rtags la bud med mtshan ma ston pa rmis na/ mo rgyud ma grub pas spaug pa'i las bya/ skyes pa gcer bur byung na pho rgyud 'khu bas gzir ba'i las bya/ 'thab rtsod byed na mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pas skong bshags bya/ sprang po byung na ma bskang bas me tshogs dang gtor tshogs bya/ mdze pho byung na grib yod pas khrus dang gtsang sbra byed/

mun nag char 'thibs byung na dam tshigs nyams pas skong bshags bya/ nyi zla nub na tshe thung bas tshe sgrub bya/ bza' btung thob khar gzhan gyis khyer bar rmis sam gnyid sad na/ za khar 'jug pa'i bgegs la mnan pa bya/ mtshon cha chag pa dang rno med na sngags la chad lhag byung bas gso bar bya/ rol mo la skad med pa rmis na bskyed rdzogs ma dag pas gsal la dag par gsal gdab/ ngu bred dang cho nges byed par rmis na srung ma ma mgu bas skong bshags dang gtor tshogs bya/ gzhan gyis 'dod pa byung na/ gzhan gyi gtor tshogs kyis ma khengs pas tshogs gtor rgya chen po gtang*/ rang nyid kun gyi gral gsham na 'dug pa rmis na/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre ma 'chun pas dmigs pa rgya bskyed/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dab rdzab kyi khrod du 'dug pa rmis na grib yod pas khrus dang skong bshags bya/ gos ngan pa gon pa rmis na bsod nams dman pas tshogs bsag /ri nas thur du 'gro ba rmis na bar chad dang skal pa ngan pas dge sbyor la 'bad cing brtson 'grus bskyed/ sa rub cing nyi zla nub pa dang*/ rgud pa dang*/ gos dmar po gon nas mchod rten dmar po la 'dzegs pa dang*/ gcer bur bong bu la zhon pa dang*/ nub tu bltas nas nyams mi dga' bzhin du nyi ma nub khar 'gro ba rmis na/ 'chi rtags yin pas 'chi bslu dang tshe sgrub la 'bad par bya'o/ /'di dag ni mdo tsam ste/ mdor na rmi lam gang yang sad dus shes pa mi dga' na nges par zhan la/ shes pa mi bde ba med na bag chags su shes par bya'o/ /de'ang srod la sngar 'das pa dang*/ bgegs kyi cho 'phrul gyi rmi lam gzhi che/ gung la bag chags dang da lta'i snang ba shas che/ tho rangs ma 'ongs pa dang lhas lung ston pa'i phyir/ mngon shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ chos mthun pas tho rangs la brtag pa yin no/ /ngan pa rnams la so so'i gnyen po rnams dang bden med kyi rtsal sbyangs pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thun mong gi mthong snang bzang ngan rnams rnal 'byor pas shes par bya ba phyir du smos pa ste/

khong du chud par bya'o/ /don gnyis pa 'od gsal mchog gi mthong snang la gnyis las/ rang rigs pa'i mthong snang la'ang bzang po ni/ gnas lugs kyi don la sbyangs pas na/ sems can la snying rje chen po 'bad med du skye ba dang*/ bla ma la gdung ba mchog tu skye ba dang*/ 'dod yon la dgos med skye ba dang*/ chags sdang gi 'dzin pa je chung la 'gro ba dang*/ rang sems la g.yo zog gi rnam pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ snying nas 'chi ba mi rtag pa skye ba dang*/ blo sna btsan thabs su thung la skyo shas gting nas skye ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba sgyu mar mthong ba dang*/ snang srid slob dpon du 'char ba dang*/ ci byas gzhan la phan pa dang*/ kun gyis mthong na dga' ba dang*/ dad mos rgyun chad med pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa chos nyid du 'char ba dang*/ chos min gyi bsam pa rgyud la mi 'byung ba dang*/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa rang babs su skye ba dang*/ gang shar rang grol du mthong ba dang*/ the tshom gyi 'dzin pa mi skye ba dang*/ bla ma'i gdams ngag la yid ches skye ba dang*/ chos kyi tshig don sngar mi shes pa rgyud la 'char ba dang*/ thams cad blo bral du shes pa la sogs pa'o/ ngan pa ni nyams su blangs pa'i tshe na/ de dag las ldog pa rgyud la 'char zhing*/ khyad par du gnas dang yul dang*/ gnyen bshes la chags sdang skye zhing*/ rdzas dang yo byad la sogs gang rung la/ chags zhen je cher gyur pa dang*/ dug lnga je rags la song bas mthun mjug dang*/ chags sdang 'bad med 'byung ba dang*/ gcig pur 'dug kyang sems nyon mongs pas g.yengs shing bya byed 'du 'dzi la dga' ba dang*/ bla ma'i gdams ngag la yid mi ches pas spros bcas kyi dge sbyor la gtso bor 'don pa dang*/ blo sna mang zhing rnam rtog je rags la 'gro ba dang*/ dgag sgrub dang 'gyur ldog mang zhing 'grogs tshad chos min la 'god pa dang*/ kha lta nyams len 'dzol bas sems la rdul tsam yang ma phan pa la sogs te/

mdor na chos dang mi mthun pa kun la rang gnas shing gzhan yang 'god pa rnams so/ /de dag la bla ma dam pa btsal nas nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gang 'gyur brten nas/ rang sems 'dul ba mchog tu zab bo/ /gnyis pa 'od lnga phyi'i mthong snang ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad rnams legs par gcun te bsgoms pas thig le stong pa'i sgron ma mtheb mdzub kyi rtsol ba dang bral yang*/ snang dus nang du gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa gnyis 'od du song bas 'khor ba'i 'ching ba las grol te/ rtsol sgrub las 'das pa'i don khong du chud pa'i ltas so/ /de dus shi yang skye ba gnyis nas sangs rgya'o/ /de nas dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma smin mtshams nas bral te 'od lnga'i snang ba dum bu la khru gang tsam pa kha dog lnga ldan gyi nang 'od zlum mu khyud ris mar por snang dus/ nang du ye shes kyi snang bas dug lnga dang sgo lnga'i 'dab 'od du song bas 'khor 'das rgyab gyes te phyi ma mngal gyi grong khyer du mi 'jug pa'i rtags so/ /de dus shi yang sprul skur skye bas 'gro drug tu mi skye'o/ /de'ang mngon dga' la sogs par rdzus te skye/ lo lnga brgya na sangs rgya ba'o/ /de nas 'od lnga'i snang ba gyen la 'greng ba dang*/ rtsibs shar dang*/ mdung rtse dang*/ mda' lta bu dang*/ re lde tsam du snang dus na/ nang du sprul pa'i zhing gi bag chags 'dzin pa'i rtsa bdun gyi rtsa gnyis re 'od du song bas dbyings rig 'dus te bar dor sangs rgya ba'o/ /de'ang snang ba'i 'od gsal mdun ngos tsam par gzhal yas khang par shar ba'i gnad kyis so/ /de'ang de dus shi na bar do gsum pa lhun grub la grol lo/ / dbyings snang la rin po che'i dra ba dra phyed dang*/ mig mangs ris dang*/ mig tshags lta bu dang*/ za 'og ber khyim dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ mdung rtse dang*/ mda' dang*/ nya mig gi rnam pa lta bu shar dus nang du longs sku'i cha 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa'i rtsa lnga brgya 'od du song bas ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi snang ba la sangs rgyas te srid pa'i bar do med do/

/de'ang chos nyid las srid pa'i bar do rang log ste/ dbyings kyi rgyan rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbyings snang gis lung pa 'gags pa ni/ nang du sgrib byed gnyis snang gi rtsa bzhi brgya 'od du song ste/ rnam rtog yul gyi zhen pa dang bral bas 'di dus shi yang*/ /zung 'jug gi snang ba la sangs rgyas pa'i rtags so/ / dbyings rig nyin mtshan med par 'dres te snang dus/ nang du sku gsum snang tshul gyi rten 'brel byed pa'i rtsa sum stong 'od du song bas 'od gsal gyi snang ba la sangs rgya'o/ /de'ang 'khor 'das gnyis su med par grol ba'i gnad kyis so/ de dag gi tshe thig le yang sran ma'i rdog po tsam las bse phub tsam gyi bar du 'phel lo/ /de'i tshe lus la gnyer ma med cing zas skom mi dgos pa dang*/ rang snang las 'bral mi phod pa dang*/ bar snang la 'gro ba dang*/ 'khrul pa'i gtam mi 'byung ba'o/ /de nas thig le re re'i nang du rigs lnga'i sku rkyang pa re shar ba dang*/ yab yum zung 'brel du shar dus/ phung po 'od gsal du grol dus/ 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa med pas skye shi las 'das te/ nang rtsa ma lus pa 'od du song nas rdos bcas su mi snang bar chu'i zla ba lta bur snang ngo*/ /de dus sku gsum gyi zhen pa chod de/ longs sku'i zhing la da lta spyod pa'o/ /de'ang longs sku'i zhing la gnyis te/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang*/ gnas skabs rnal 'byor pa'i zhing ngo*/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni sangs rgyas nas longs skur bzhengs dus na'o/ /rnal 'byor pa la gnyis las/ tshad du phyin pa mngon sum gyis snang ba nas/ gong 'phel gyi snang ba rdzogs pa tshun chad do/ /phyin pa ni rig pa tshad phebs te/ 'di dag la longs sku'i zhing nyul ba zhes bya ste gong nas gong du 'gro zhing sangs rgyas kyi sar brtan pa thob dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas nas longs sku'i zhing brtan pa zhes bya ste/ mi 'gyur zhing mthar thug pa'i phyir ro/

/de nas 'od kyi nang na lag sor bkram pa tsam las mi mngon pas na phyi nang gi 'khrul snang zad de/ sems can gyi don du 'pho ba'i skur padma lta bur 'byung zhing kha cig gdod ma'i sar grol nas sprul pas don mdzad pa'o/ /de'ang phyi snang ba'i 'od gsal las/ nang rigs pa'i 'od gsal 'byongs te/ gsang ba chos nyid kyi 'od gsal du grol bar byed pas na chos tshul 'di ni kun las khyad par 'phags so/ /e ma ho/ yang gsang snying po mkha' 'gro snying tig las/ / mthong snang sna tshogs gser gyi dra ba can/ /gang gis goms shing bsgrubs las mngon du snang*/ /'di yang rang rig goms pa'i cho 'phrul tsam/ /snang srid snod bcud dag dang ma dag kun/ /grib ma gzugs la shar ba chos nyid dang*/ /'od gsal gdangs las so sor snang na yang*/ /rang byung ye shes gzugs gzhan 'pho 'gyur med/ /dag dang ma dag grim ma ji bzhin yang*/ / gdod ma'i ngang las shar der mtha' yang grol/ /'khor 'das snang rtags shin tu dag pa'i tshe/ /gdod ma'i sar phyin rmi lam sad pa 'dra/ /bzang ngan gnyis med mnyam rdzogs blo bde 'o/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /yo rgyan rdzong du ddi med 'od zer gyis/ /phyi rabs don du snang bar byas pa yin/ /mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba rdzogs so// // dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba/ -PAGE 354--PAGE 355--PAGE 347-
